title: Built my first mobile game twice - w/Astra and Fable 5.1
author: Ybot4000
selftext:
This project had 2 reasons behind it.

1. I am a full time developer that wanted to check and compare the abilities of these two frontrunners LLMs myself.
2. I am a gamer and figured - why not try making something fun in the process?

I have done other tests before but thought - why not try and make something fun while testing it?

The result is: **TEN GOALS!**, a soccer arcade game where you have a tight arcade loop with multiple modes and want to aim for the top of the leaderboards.

Happy to break down any part of the workflow, from the initial prompt to the design changes I requested and the back and forth integration with google (Play integrity, closed testing, performance).

I behaved the same with both, same prompts both ultracode setting.(max reasoning available)

At the end I was happier with Fable 5.1 version and decided to release it!

Would appreciate if you checked it out! Feedback is very welcome <3

[https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tengoals.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.tengoals.game)
